body.statement: When \(K=2\), projection of \(\mathcal R(P)\) onto \(q(1)\) equals the sharp interval \([V^-(P),V^+(P)]\) from Shahn2026Oracle, so the construction introduces no extra restriction in the binary-outcome special case.
body.justification: The reduction is the required sanity check against the known sharp binary recursion.
body.gap: This is a compatibility corollary rather than a novelty claim.
body.consumer: Existing binary oracle analyses can adopt the full-law machinery without changing their established endpoints.
